basic_details.job_title: NeGD Technical Lead Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The National e-Governance Division (NeGD), an independent business division under Digital India Corporation, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, has invited online applications for 5 Technical Lead posts on contract, initially for 3 years and extendable as per the requirement of the project. Applicants need a Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field and 8-10 years of experience in software development. The maximum age limit is 55 years. Apply at https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/ by 30 November 2026.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit is 55 years on the closing date of receipt of application. The notice prints no minimum age and no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

qualification.details: Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Experience: 8-10 years of experience in software development, with at least 8 years in a leadership or senior developer role. Proven experience leading development teams in a technical capacity, preferably in an Agile environment. Strong experience with software design and architecture, and deep knowledge of programming languages (e.g., Java, Python, C#, JavaScript, etc.).

how_to_apply: Eligible candidates may apply online at https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/ on or before 30.11.2026. The notice says the details can be downloaded from the official websites of DIC and NeGD, www.dic.gov.in and www.negd.gov.in. The notice does not describe the individual steps of the online form.

A No Objection Certificate from the employer, for candidates already in regular or contractual employment under Central or State Government, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies. Such candidates are expected to apply through proper channel or attach the certificate with the application, or produce it at the time of interview.
important_instructions: NeGD reserves the right to fill all, some or none of the positions advertised without assigning any reason. The place of posting is New Delhi but transferable to project locations of NeGD as per existing policy of NeGD/DIC. For queries, contact the HR Team, National e Governance Division, 4th Floor, Electronics Niketan, 6-CGO, Complex Lodhi Road, New Delhi – 110003, Email: [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About NeGD
content_sections.text: The National e-Governance Division is an independent business division under the Digital India Corporation, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, with its office at Electronics Niketan, 6, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi. The notice says NeGD supports MeitY in programme management and implementation of e-Governance projects of Central and State Ministries and Departments. Its initiatives under the Digital India Programme include DigiLocker, UMANG, Poshan Tracker, OpenForge Platform, API Setu, National Academic Depository, Academic Bank of Credits and Learning Management System.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Experience: 8-10 years of experience in software development, with at least 8 years in a leadership or senior developer role. Proven experience leading development teams in a technical capacity, preferably in an Agile environment. Strong experience with software design and architecture, and deep knowledge of programming languages (e.g., Java, Python, C#, JavaScript, etc.). Proficient in web development frameworks, databases (SQL, NoSQL), cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). Strong understanding of version control (e.g., Git), CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing. Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management tools (e.g., JIRA, Trello). Relevant certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure, Scrum Master) are a plus. Experience with cloud-native application architectures. Familiarity with microservices, event-driven architectures, and serverless computing. Experience with API design and integration (RESTful APIs). Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation). The maximum age limit is 55 years on the closing date of receipt of application. The notice prints no minimum age and no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Technical Lead posts are purely on contract basis, initially for a period of 3 years, which is further extendable as per the requirement of the project. The positions are purely temporary in nature for the project of NeGD/DIC, and appointees shall not derive any right or claim for permanent appointment at NeGD/DIC or on any vacancies existing or advertised in future. NeGD reserves the right to terminate the appointments with a notice of one month or without any notice by paying one month's salary in lieu of the notice period. The designation of the selected candidates shall be mapped as per the existing designation policy of NeGD.

content_sections.heading: NeGD Technical Lead Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice describes the role as overseeing the technical aspects of software development projects, guiding development teams, ensuring the quality of code and providing technical solutions to complex challenges. The key responsibilities are: Technical Leadership and Mentorship: lead and mentor a team of developers; provide technical guidance and ensure best practices across the software development lifecycle; conduct regular code reviews; assist with resolution of complex technical issues. Architecture and Design: collaborate with Solution Architects, product managers and other stakeholders on scalable, secure and efficient technical solutions; take ownership of technical designs; ensure the team follows established architecture and design patterns. Project Delivery: oversee technical execution so tasks are delivered on time, within scope and to a high standard; act as a point of escalation for technical challenges; work with the project management team to estimate timelines and prioritise tasks. Collaboration and Communication: serve as a liaison between technical and non-technical teams; work with business analysts, QA, operations and product managers; participate in sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives. Continuous Improvement: identify opportunities for process improvement; encourage the team to explore new tools, frameworks and technologies; promote a culture of learning and development. Quality Assurance and Testing: ensure the team follows unit, integration and automated testing practices; maintain high standards of code quality and reliability; collaborate with the QA team on testing coverage and timely resolution of bugs.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NeGD Technical Lead
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates may apply online at https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/ on or before 30.11.2026. The notice says the details can be downloaded from the official websites of DIC and NeGD, www.dic.gov.in and www.negd.gov.in . The notice does not describe the individual steps of the online form. A No Objection Certificate from the employer, for candidates already in regular or contractual employment under Central or State Government, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies. Such candidates are expected to apply through proper channel or attach the certificate with the application, or produce it at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Screening of applications will be based on qualifications, age and relevant experience. NeGD reserves the right to fix a higher threshold of qualifications and experience for screening and for limiting the number of candidates called for interview. Only shortlisted candidates shall be invited for interviews. NeGD also reserves the right not to select any of the candidates without assigning any reason. The notice does not mention an interview date or venue.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: NeGD reserves the right to fill all, some or none of the positions advertised without assigning any reason. The place of posting is New Delhi but transferable to project locations of NeGD as per existing policy of NeGD/DIC. For queries, contact the HR Team, National e Governance Division, 4th Floor, Electronics Niketan, 6-CGO, Complex Lodhi Road, New Delhi – 110003, Email: [email protected] .
